implementation.name: Gameboy (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 70 HDL source files (12 systemverilog, 28 verilog, 30 vhdl) alongside 50 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Game Boy and Game Boy Color, plus the Mega Duck / Cougar Boy: the distribution's _Console/GameboyColor.mgl and _Console/Mega Duck.mgl both name <rbf>_Console/Gameboy</rbf>, giving machine_id gameboy and machine_id gbcolor and machine_id megaduck. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file; the grant lives in the source header at https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Gameboy_MiSTer/blob/master/Gameboy.sv, which offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 70 source files (12 systemverilog, 28 verilog, 30 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
